content.value_statement: Choosing a music model can waste time and budget. This skill routes requests to RunComfy music endpoints and prepares the right prompt format.
actual_capabilities: Routes music requests across ElevenLabs Music, ACE Step, ACE Step 1.5, audio-inpaint, and audio-outpaint.
Helps choose between premium vocal output, low-cost drafts, multilingual vocals, and audio edits.
Provides RunComfy CLI patterns for text-to-music generation and existing-audio editing.
Explains prompt structures for style tags, lyrics, section markers, durations, and time ranges.
Documents token handling, endpoint allowlists, and generated file size boundaries.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and valid authentication before running jobs.
Model use can incur costs, especially for premium vocal generation.
Does not verify rights to lyrics, melodies, samples, or uploaded audio.
Audio edit routes require a source audio URL that the service can access.

use_cases.title: Draft Low-Cost Background Tracks
use_cases.description: Create many instrumental drafts for videos, games, or social posts while keeping model cost low.

use_cases.title: Create Polished Vocal Hooks
use_cases.description: Prepare premium music prompts with lyrics, sections, duration, and style details for brand or campaign work.

use_cases.title: Repair Or Extend Existing Audio
use_cases.description: Select inpaint or outpaint workflows to replace a timed section or lengthen a short track.

prompt_templates.title: Generate A Simple Instrumental
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 45 second instrumental background track for a calm product demo. Keep cost low and recommend the best RunComfy route.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Short Jingle
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 15 second upbeat brand jingle with a clear chorus, bright pop style, and concise lyrics. Prioritize polished output.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A Multilingual Song
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60 second pop song concept that can be rendered in English, Spanish, and Japanese using the same style tags.

prompt_templates.title: Edit And Extend A Track
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a 30 second hook. Recommend how to replace the weak middle section, then extend it into a two minute track.

output_examples.input: I need a cheap 60 second instrumental loop for a mobile game.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends ACE Step base, explains the cost fit, and prepares tags for a consistent loop bed.

output_examples.input: Repair the second chorus of my existing pop track.
output_examples.output: The skill selects audio-inpaint, asks for the source audio URL and time range, and describes the replacement section.

output_examples.input: Create a polished 20 second vocal jingle for a campaign launch.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends ElevenLabs Music, drafts a compact section plan, and notes the higher premium model cost.

best_practices: Start with short drafts before paying for longer premium renders.
Confirm lyric and audio rights before generating or editing tracks.
Use clear style tags, durations, sections, and edit time ranges.
anti_patterns: Do not use premium models for large draft batches without a budget reason.
Do not upload or reference audio that the user did not provide for the task.
Do not place API tokens, private URLs, or unreleased lyrics in prompts or logs.

faq.question: Does this skill generate music directly?
faq.answer: It prepares and runs RunComfy CLI workflows for supported music models when the CLI is available.

faq.question: Which models does it route to?
faq.answer: It covers ElevenLabs Music, ACE Step, ACE Step 1.5, audio-inpaint, and audio-outpaint endpoints.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing track?
faq.answer: Yes. It can choose audio-inpaint for timed section repair or audio-outpaint for extending a track.

faq.question: Does it require authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The RunComfy CLI needs login or a valid RUNCOMFY_TOKEN before jobs can run.

faq.question: Can it help control cost?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares low-cost ACE Step routes with premium ElevenLabs Music routes before choosing.

faq.question: Does it check music rights?
faq.answer: No. Users must confirm they have rights to lyrics, samples, source audio, and final usage.
